name: Article 12, after § 4 – 55
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on the structure and rates of excise duty applied to tobacco and tobacco related products (recast)
part_text: 2. The Union rate used to determine the minimum tax level of a product, as provided for in Article 16, Article 20(2) and Article 22(2) shall be adjusted by increasing or decreasing the base amount in euro by the percentage change over the preceding 3 calendar years in the all-items annual Union average value of the harmonised index of consumer prices excluding energy and unprocessed food as published by Eurostat. The Union rate used to determine the minimum tax level of a product shall not be adjusted by more than 9 %.
